data.about: Over 11 years, I've worked across backend and data engineering: designing distributed services in Go and Node.js, building large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines in Python and SQL, and running cloud data platforms on Snowflake, BigQuery, Airflow, and Kafka. My work has spanned fintech, compliance, and consumer tech — from transaction-monitoring pipelines to internal data platforms used by hundreds of engineers. Currently, I'm a contractor with Coinbase, building compliance data pipelines and integrating AI agent tooling (MCP, Claude Code) directly into production monitoring systems — one of the earlier hands-on applications of agentic AI in a live compliance workflow. Before that, I built data platforms and a GenAI/RAG-based query assistant at Gojek (GoTo Financial), and shipped full-stack products earlier in my career.Always glad to connect with fellow engineers, and open to conversations about backend/data engineering roles — full-time or contract — where I can own systems end-to-end.
